description: 경기도_버스전용차로 현황 [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 경기도. 이 데이터는 경기도 내 버스전용차로의 설치 및 운영 현황을 정리한 자료로, 구간별 전용차로 노선명, 연장거리(km), 운영시간, 시행일자, 차로종류 등의 항목을 포함합니다. Coverage: 경기도. The portal files it under the publisher 경기도. Its tags are 버스전용차로, 교통정책, 노선정보, 운영시간, 전용차로종류. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-06-27 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
